name: TC-44: owner can delete a menu item
statusMessage: The menu item CARD has no delete button — only Edit Item and Clone Item. Item deletion lives on the item DETAIL page (Delete → soft delete, gated by DELETE_MENU_ITEM) and is covered by TC-302 in 04c-menu-item-editor.spec.ts (plus the 409 deal-blocker path in TC-303).
